content.short: Maian provides automated vulnerability tracing in Ethereum smart contracts.
content.description: Maian is the Python model of MAIAN, developed by Ivica Nikolic, that automatically detects vulnerabilities across three categories: suicidal, prodigal, and greedy. It comes with a graphical user interface to simplify testing. Using the prodigal-type scan flag, developers can verify whether a smart contract can send ETH to any address. The tool can analyze both Solidity source and bytecode smart contracts. It supports auditing on multiple networks, including Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Multichain, Base, and OP Mainnet. The project is open-source.
